name: pc.notification-delivery-cancellation-receipt.v1
requirements: AF-27 ASYNC-NOTIFICATION: cancellation is durable intent, never erasure, delivery success or proof of no gateway effect.

Bounded initiating trigger: committed CFG-OP-UPDATE-NOTIFICATION-ENDPOINT under ACT-NOTIFICATION_ENDPOINTS_UPDATE_RESOURCE-V1, actual authenticated Participant user authorization, fresh WebAuthn <=5m, and original signed Control business transition. ACK is never cancellation; no new public cancel action is invented.

The source owner must verify original operation SUCCEEDED, native business receipt and complete before/after endpoint state preimages in the same Participant/privacy scope: occurrence endpointId and endpointRevision equal the replaced predecessor, successor revision is exactly predecessor+1, verification is cleared and successor is DISABLED or preserves QUARANTINED. Bind the actual operation UUID, profile digest, receipt payload digest and both state digests. A caller digest/descriptor or the current endpoint row alone is not authority.

The cancellation owner uses actual TLS/Identity and the installed LS-NOTIFICATION delivery worker, original occurrence/request/source custody and current worker authority. It must not require send capacity, active replaced endpoint, delivery credential bytes, KMS unwrap or a gateway call to record this restricting intent.

Canonical delivery before/after preimages bind the exact delivery row, revision, original attempt/start/dispatch and authenticated outcome lineage. For PENDING with attemptCount=0, CANCELLED_BEFORE_START sets cancelRequested and CANCELLED. RETRY_WAIT requires the original authenticated RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT outcome before PREVENT_LATER_ATTEMPTS may set CANCELLED. STARTED/AMBIGUOUS sets cancelRequested but preserves the exact original state, attempt, claim, signed bytes and RECONCILE_ORIGINAL. Missing claim, absent/expired lease, timeout, transport loss or cancellation cannot establish no effect.

Hold existing evidence lifecycle then delivery row fences, serialize with material/dispatch, and atomically commit the signed transition, immutable cause binding, revision+1 and durable readback. No caller-fabricated success, generic UPDATE or copied capability. Actual signer admission for this distinct purpose remains required; wire registration grants no signing or SQL authority.

Idempotency is exact occurrence plus cause operation; preserve original receipt/payload/COSE and resulting revision across lost ACK/restart. Readback verifies original installed signer and complete state/cause chain, returns cancellation disposition separately from gateway outcome, and never remints a send/claim. Terminal replay returns the original; a new terminal cancellation is not manufactured.
